```sql
WITH GenderOrderCount AS (
    SELECT 
        c.gender_code, 
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM 
        Customers c
    LEFT JOIN 
        Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        c.gender_code
),
MinOrderCount AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(order_count) AS min_order_count
    FROM 
        GenderOrderCount
)
SELECT 
    c.email_address, 
    c.town_city, 
    c.county
FROM 
    Customers c
JOIN 
    Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

    GenderOrderCount goc ON c.gender_code = goc.gender_code
JOIN 
    MinOrderCount moc ON goc.order_count = moc.min_order_count;
```
query:
WITH GenderOrderCount AS (
    SELECT 
        c.gender_code, 
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM 
        Customers c
    LEFT JOIN 
        Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        c.gender_code
),
MinOrderCount AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(order_count) AS min_order_count
    FROM 
        GenderOrderCount
)
SELECT 
    c.email_address, 
    c.town_city, 
    c.county
FROM 
    Customers c
JOIN 
    Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

    GenderOrderCount goc ON c.gender_code = goc.gender_code

    MinOrderCount moc ON goc.order_count = moc.min_order_count

```sql
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring
```
```sql
    GROUP BY student_id, behaviour_monitoring_details
```
